prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” painter, but **Rice Painting** is a strong St. Louis option to consider for residential interiors. The company says it received *St. Louis At Home* magazine’s “Best of Everything – Best Interior Painting” award in 2009 and is based in Webster Groves. [Rice Painting](https://www.ricepainting.com/interior-painting)

For another candidate, **Better Painting** serves St. Louis and nearby communities and offers interior painting. [Better Painting](https://betterpainting.com/services/interior-painting/)

Before choosing, get at least three written estimates and compare prep work, paint and materials, schedule, warranty, and proof of insurance. Ratings and awards are useful starting points, not guarantees of a good fit.
